entities.summary: Gorkys Gustavo Hernández Lugo is a Venezuelan professional baseball outfielder for the Saraperos de Saltillo of the Mexican League. Hernandez signed with the Detroit Tigers in 2005. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Pittsburgh Pirates, Miami Marlins, San Francisco Giants, and Boston Red Sox. He is signed to the Caribes de Anzoátegui of the Venezuelan Professional Baseball League.
